subject: Following up on the document
text:
Hello,

I hope you are well. I wanted to follow up about the document we discussed two days ago. If you have a chance to send it, I would appreciate it, because I need to complete a small submission before the weekend. No rush if you are busy, but even a scan or photo would help. Let me know if you need any details from me or if there is a better way to transfer it. I am sorry for asking.

Thank you for your patience.
